paper.title: Observation of room-temperature superconductivity in nitrogen-doped lutetium hydride under high pressure

disclaimer: This data is extracted from a non-peer-reviewed arXiv preprint (2025). The results have not been independently verified and are subject to scrutiny. Previous high-profile claims from the same group (e.g., C-S-H, 2020) were later retracted. Use with caution.
notes: The paper claims room-temperature superconductivity at only 1 GPa, which is orders of magnitude lower than typical hydride superconductors (100+ GPa). This is a remarkable claim that requires independent replication.
